name: components-community-radial-intro
title: Radial Intro
blurb: Images orbit around a center point in a continuous loop.
description: Animates items in orbital motion around a central stage. Uses Framer Motion spring physics for smooth rotation and item appearance.
use_when: Logo walls, team showcases, or circular feature displays.
avoid_when: Motion-sensitive users (continuous, no prefers-reduced-motion); low-bandwidth (animation overhead).
a11y: Purely decorative animation loop. No interactive elements.
